payload.artist_html: G. Mayr, L. Šmídová, A. Richter & S. Wedmann
payload.credit_html: "Evidence for diurnal habits in an exceptionally preserved Eocene owl"
payload.description_html:
Holotype of Masillastrix blattophaga from Messel:

(A and B) The two slabs before preparation (A, SMF-ME 11964A; B, SMF-ME 11964B); the circled area in (A) denotes the swallowed cockroach, of which an enlarged detail is shown.

(C and D) Main slab (SMF-ME 11964A) after removal of the insect and transfer into resin; the specimen in (D) was coated with ammonium chloride.
